class.name: Item
class.brief_description: A resource class that defines items in the UT-Godot-Engine.
class.description:
The [Item] class is a resource used to define all items in the game (consumable items, weapons, armor, and miscellaneous). You can set the item type, stats, usage messages, and more.
[b]Item Types:[/b] • [constant CONSUMABLE]: Recovery items that are consumed after use • [constant WEAPON]: Equipment that increases attack power • [constant ARMOR]: Equipment that increases defense power • [constant MISC]: Miscellaneous items that do not fit into the other categories
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: get_item_name_tr
method.description: Returns a translated version of the item name. This method returns the item's name as a translated string according to the current locale.

members.member: Detailed information about the item. This is the description displayed when viewing items in the inventory.
The name of the item. Displayed in the inventory and menus.
The type of the item. One of CONSUMABLE (consumable item), WEAPON (weapon), or ARMOR (armor).
Messages displayed when the item is discarded. Each string is displayed sequentially.
Messages displayed when the item is used. Each element in the array is displayed sequentially.

constants.constant: Performs a frying pan attack effect.
A consumable item. Takes effect when used and is consumed.
Miscellaneous item. An item that is neither consumed nor equipped.
